notes: Checks apply to installed non-Kiwix assets with publisher URLs. Shared source URLs are checked once per interval.
Changes are reported for review; fixed editions, generated files and extracted packages are not silently overwritten.
PDF and Word responses are validated. HTML is checked for meaningful text changes; archive packages use publisher metadata only.
An initial HTML or archive check establishes a baseline, not proof that the saved snapshot is current.
Curriculum PDFs use bounded publisher metadata checks instead of re-downloading the teaching library each week. An initial metadata baseline is not a content-freshness guarantee.
